messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] paging-gateway: sustained elevated 5xx and streaming disconnects detected across us-west-2 region. error-rate ~7% over last 3m for /v1/paged-stream endpoints. possible chunked encoding failures and client cancellations. paging fanout latency also spiking. paging-gateway cluster: pgw-prod-usw2-1

Sarah K: ack. oncall here, investigating. assigning myself primary triage.

Mike R: seeing increased 502s from the gateway in logs, looks correlated with fanout to dedicated backends. sample log: 
```
2026-03-14T22:14:02Z pgw-prod us-west-2 request_id=abc123 route=/v1/paged-stream backend_error=upstream_reset_by_peer chunked: true
```

Raj P: also seeing a lot of client cancellations immediately after first chunk. maybe clients hitting timeout on initial chunks? 95th perc latency for first-byte jumped from 120ms -> 1.2s last 5m.

Sarah K: good context. impact: partial streaming responses for paged requests; non-paged single-pass requests unaffected. estimated ~1.1k req/min impacted, several customer support tickets.

Leo T: quick check: gateway connection pool for fanout is saturated, retries are failing with TLS handshake timeouts. nginx stats show high keepalive_timeouts.

Mike R: temporary mitigation idea: reduce fanout concurrency and failover to non-paginated route for affected customers, and enable additional gateway retries with exponential backoff. can we flip a config?

Sarah K: let's avoid risky deploys. prefer Live Mitigation steps: 1) set paging-fanout concurrency to 4 (was 16), 2) enable gateway short-retries, 3) route high-latency tenants to single-stream fallback. I'm going to run the toggles now.

Sarah K: running toggle commands: 
```bash
# reduce fanout concurrency
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_OPS" \
  https://config-redwood.internal/v1/flags/paging_fanout_concurrency \
  -d '{"value":4}'

# enable gateway short retries
curl -X POST https://config-redwood.internal/v1/flags/gateway_enable_short_retries -d '{"value":true}'
```

incident-bot: config-change recorded: flags/paging_fanout_concurrency -> 4 by Sarah K at 22:17 UTC.

Raj P: toggles applied. I can see concurrency drop reflected in pgw metrics. errors dipped slightly, 5xx -> 4.5% now. streaming disconnect rate down 35% for sampled tenants.

Elaine O: I'll open a temporary bypass for a few enterprise customers that reported cancellations; move them to dedicated non-paged endpoints. list? @Sarah K can you paste tenant ids?

Sarah K: pasting tenants into thread: tenant_omega, tenant_zephyr, tenant_neo. Elaine, request ID: 0a1b2c to whitelist them for fallback.

Leo T: adding gateway-level mitigation: increase http chunked_read_timeout to 10s (was 3s) for us-west-2 to allow slow initial chunk assembly. small risk to resource usage but reduces client cancels.

Mike R: apply change carefully. command: 
```yaml
- target: gateway/usw2
  set: http_chunked_read_timeout: 10s
```

Sarah K: change applied via rolling config; monitoring.

incident-bot: Metric update: 22:25 UTC - 5xx down to 3.1%; chunked disconnects down 42% since mitigations started.

Raj P: still seeing intermittent 502s from a specific backend pool ip range 10.20.30.0/27, might be a flaky instance-level issue. ordering a drain of that pool.

Elaine O: draining pool now: 
```bash
# mark pool for drain
opsctl backend drain --pool pgw-pool-7 --region usw2 --reason "streaming disconnects"
```

Leo T: pool drained and nodes rebooted, healthchecks passing again.

Sarah K: customer impact update: affected tenants experienced partial stream cancels between 22:12-22:30 UTC. Support notified and CS rep assigned. no data loss reported, only incomplete streams.

Mike R: proposed follow-ups: 1) reproduce chunked cancel locally with simulated slow-client, 2) add histogram on first-byte latency per route, 3) add alert for fanout concurrency saturation.

Sarah K: agree. creating follow-up ticket and owner. Ticket: INF-5123. Owner: Raj. ETA tomorrow 10:00 PST.

Raj P: taking INF-5123. I'll also add a runbook step to disable paging fanout automatically if backend error-rate > 3% for 2m.

Sarah K: handing off to Elaine for next shift. I'll be available if escalation needed. Elaine, you're primary for the next 8h.

Elaine O: on it. thumbs up. I'll verify customer follow-ups and watch the dashboards through morning. please DM if anything regress. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE logged. severity: high -> mitigated (live mitigation in place). handoff: Sarah K -> Elaine O at 22:38 UTC.

oncall: acked handoff. monitoring continues.

Elaine O: note for handover log: mitigation steps, flags changed, drained pool, tenants moved to fallback, ticket INF-5123 tracked. I'll coordinate postmortem tomorrow.
